notes.title: Version 0.9.30
notes.content:
[h2][b]Whats New?[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] The ship at Umbra Cave will be available for all players with 5 Honor Badges! The lands beyond are still a work in progress, but you will be able to roam freely and battle some new enemies in the meantime
[*] Dedicated bestiary to track your fusion entries and hints in the world to help unlock recipes
[*] Bestiary Improvements to display entry numbers for easier tracking.
[*] More NPCs with information at Delfos
[*] Minotaur Labyrinth polished
[*] New enemies have been added
[*] First fusion fix, door should not open until you make your first fusion
[*] Construct NPCs at Eastern Island fixed
[*] The second NPC with Otiosus now dissapear after you speak with any of them
[*] A path block was added at Vesper Castle to force the events of the quest
[*] Fangstorm Gloryrise chance was changed to always 100% (aka immortal)
[*] Lala the Witch has been removed from Vesper Castle and is now stays at the Cemetery to craft talismans; a future update will relocate her to a more accessible spot for easier recruitment.
[*] Sword in the Stone now requires more STR to be pulled off
[*] Zatoichi fight now is a One on One fight
[*] Psi Puzzle board added in Eastern Island
[*] Psi and Tau puzzle art swapped
[*] The sneaky Scimitar Sword is now easier to acquire. It's available for purchase at the Palala Shop
[*] Fixes on Typos, Wording and bugs reported by the community
[/list]
[h2][b]Coming Next[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Boss Fight logic
[*] Navigable Minimap
[*] More Content
[*] More Polish
[/list]
[h2][b]Known Issues[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Rabbiwatt second promotion is not working
[*] Medusa’s Dungeon: Not meant to be accessed yet. That puzzle is still a work in progress.
[*] A Hoof is showing up as a weapon instead of a loot item.
[*] Some Gear Skills are not working properly.
[*] Aftergame Access: We're polishing access to most of the aftergame content. Those who defeat Quercus will need to wait just a bit longer
[*] Windowed Mode: Switching to windowed mode may affect camera zoom
[*] Steam Deck: Sidebar is not fully visible
[*] Directional Bug: Player sometimes faces the wrong direction after entering a new area
[*] Scene Transitions: Brief flicker where player appears during fade-to-black
[*] Boulder Movement: Boulders may visibly shift when re-entering a location
[*] Caps Not Working: Time played, crowns, and item count caps are currently not enforced
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.9.25
notes.content:
[h2][b]What's new?[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Quercus Colosseum fight for the fifth medal is now working properly. Go for it!
[*] First iteration of Game Credits has been implemented.
[*] Aftergame content now unlocks after viewing the game credits.
[*] Highland Ship bug displaying incorrect travel animations has been fixed.
[*] Transition screen issue where all transitions turned white instead of black has been resolved.
[*] All previously missing achievements and medals now function correctly.
[*] Note: Some medals and achievements remain intentionally impossible to obtain.
[*] New assets added for Wild Beasts weapons.
[*] BGM now plays for Promote, Catch, and Badge Earned events.
[*] Wild Beasts now generate with unique stat seeds.
[*] Letalis that cannot promote no longer trigger the promotion event.
[*] Letalis in the Codex are now properly centered.
[*] Hidden nature for Wild Beasts has been updated with nerfed stats.
[*] Last Will image size has been adjusted.
[*] Bandits' Hideout missing color palette has been fixed.
[*] Numerous minor visual and bug fixes.
[/list]
[h2][b]Known Issues[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Sometimes, REVEAL does not work with the Perk active
[*] Some caught Wild Beast have different weapons and gears than intended.
[*] Not an issue, but we are polishing the access to most of the Aftergame content. Those who defeat Quercus will have to wait a little bit longer!
[*] Windowed Mode Issue: Switching to Windowed mode causes the game to change the camera zoom.
[*] Steam Deck Issue: Sidebar isn’t fully visible on the Steam Deck
[*] Directional Bug: Player occasionally faces the wrong direction after entering a location
[*] Transition Bug: When switching scenes, the player flashes one time in the dark during the transition
[*] Boulder Relocation: Boulders visibly move when exiting a location
[*] Caps Malfunction: Limits for game time, crowns, and items are not working properly
[/list]

notes.title: Letalis Early Access Available Now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=zSVHX1RQJ-w;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b][/b][/h2]
Thank you for joining us on this incredible journey as we launch [b]LETALIS in Early Access![/b]
We’re excited to share our plans for completing the full game!

[h2][b]What’s Next?[/b][/h2]
Here’s a glimpse of the adventure that awaits you:
[olist]
[*] [b]MANAGE YOUR COLOSSEUM[/b] - Rise to power as a Caesar and defend your Colosseum from challengers in epic battles!
[*] [b]CATCH WILD BEASTS[/b] - Defeat wild beasts and use weapon skills with the CATCH stat to claim the last beast standing as your own. Wild Beasts become Letalis, inheriting the Fighting Style of their catcher.
[*] [b]FUSE LETALIS[/b] - Discover a secret lab where you can fuse Humanoid Letalis with Wild Beasts to create the ultimate Gladiator Beast Letalis!
[*] [b]BOSS FIGHTS[/b] - Bosses are evolving! While currently resembling regular battles, future updates will give them unique mechanics and features.
[*] [b]COMBAT SKILLS[/b] - Experiment with over 200 combat skills, with even more being fine-tuned and added throughout Early Access.
[*] [b]BESTIARY[/b] - Track your collected Letalis and their stats in an organized Bestiary.
[*] [b]DELFOS TEST[/b] - Unlock Delfos, a special area for explorers, by passing a challenging quiz.
[*] [b]NEW GAME PLUS[/b] - Prepare for a second adventure set 15 years after the main game, with new stories, challenges, and a world full of surprises.
[/olist]
Next week, we’ll be sharing our roadmap, including specific delivery dates for major features. Alongside these, we’ll regularly release minor features, content updates, and bug fixes.

Stay tuned! Each update will come with a notification to keep you informed about what’s new.

[h2][b]Thank You![/b][/h2]
Your feedback and support during this Early Access stage are invaluable. Together, we’ll shape LETALIS into a truly legendary experience!

Let us know your thoughts, suggestions, and feedback in:
[list]
[*] Steam Community forums
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/q3ypj2QwJn]Letalis Discord Channel[/url]
[/list]

[b]See you in the arena! [/b]
